title: Episode 126, "A Escolha de Owen" — ge.globo interview with FLACOGOMEZ
publicLabel: Kairos Universe, Episode 126 ("A Escolha de Owen")
notes: Episode 126 narrates the interview Vincente Galán gives to a ge.globo journalist at 10:51 and states that ge.globo publishes it at 19:14 the same day.

The episode shows only the headline, the standfirst and a summary of the article; the full text in data/publications was written for Kairospedia strictly from the interview scene (questions and answers) and the facts of Episodes 122 and 126.
The episode labels the piece 'Reportagem fictícia no universo Kairos'. Backs the Kairospedia publication entrevista-ge-globo-flacogomez.
